subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should the remaining durable-approval work be rebuilt narrowly on current main, or should maintainers resolve and revalidate this full 15-conflict aggregate?
rationale: The native component has already landed independently, while this aggregate also carries security-sensitive authorization and session-state work; choosing the landing vehicle determines whether maintainers review a small unique delta or a broad conflict resolution.

options.title: Rebuild Narrowly
options.body: Create a clean current-main branch with only the unique remaining session replay, fail-closed gate, and necessary gate-repair changes.

options.title: Repair Aggregate
options.body: Resolve every conflict here and repeat complete compatibility, security, session, Android, iPhone, and Watch validation.

options.title: Pause Or Retire
options.body: Stop using this branch if current main and narrower follow-up work already cover all meaningful behavior.

recommendation.title: Rebuild Narrowly
recommendation.body: Create a clean current-main branch with only the unique remaining session replay, fail-closed gate, and necessary gate-repair changes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person coordinated the stacked components and aggregate landing branch and is best positioned to identify the intended unique remainder.
